capabilities: Save named versions (stands) of a note and compare or restore them
Mark word-level differences as CriticMarkup suggestions
Accept, reject or comment on each suggestion in a review sidebar
Send the file back and take over returned rounds without overwriting
Release a clean v1 that strips comments and sets frontmatter status
extras: Local-only: no network access and no other plugin needed. The stands folder appears in search, graph and quick switcher until excluded; on Mac, Send back opens the exported file in the default app instead of a share sheet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in track changes, so reworking a Markdown file someone sent you leaves no readable record of what changed to accept or reject.
summary: Track-changes plugin for Markdown with per-note versions, word-level CriticMarkup suggestions, comments and a review sidebar.
